SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth 
WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME') 
AND Date LIKE '2013%'
SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME') AND Date LIKE '2013%'

SELECT AVG(C.Consumption) 
FROM yearmonth C 
JOIN transactions_1k T ON C.CustomerID = T.CustomerID 
WHERE C.Date LIKE '2013%' AND T.GasStationID IN (SELECT GasStationID FROM gasstations WHERE Segment = 'SME')

SELECT AVG(T2.Consumption) 
FROM yearmonth AS T2 
INNER JOIN customers AS T1 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
WHERE T2.Date LIKE '2013-%' AND T1.Segment = 'SME'

SELECT AVG(C.Consumption) 
FROM yearmonth C 
JOIN customers G ON C.CustomerID = G.CustomerID 
WHERE C.Date >= '2013-01-01' AND C.Date < '2014-01-01' AND G.Segment = 'SME'
